verdict.rationale: Belvo's homepage advertises official "Belvo MCPs" for connecting AI agents to open finance, and its developer docs offer one-click "Install MCP server" options for Cursor and VS Code. The evidence is only a marketing tagline and install buttons, though. It is unclear whether the docs-page MCP exposes Belvo's financial API operations or only the documentation. missing for 10: documented MCP tool and capability list, setup and authentication guide, clarity on whether the server covers API actions versus docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
